profile_text.body:
Palantir is a public company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Palo Alto, traded under the ticker PLTR. On its website the company says it builds software that empowers organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions, and operations, and it presents the tagline "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today."

Its tracked AI offering is Palantir AIP, listed in the data and analytics AI category. The company describes it as an enterprise AI platform with Ontology-based governance, a defense and intelligence focus, and influence over high-stakes decisions.

The company's SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001321655. A case listed alongside the company, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, appears in the District Court for the District of Delaware.
